text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was teaching Fusaichi 
Pandora when to make her move when running 
a specific distance. However—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh, no way~ That's such a hassle.
choice_data_list:
Still, you won't win unless you learn it, 
you know?

Still, you won't win unless you learn it, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you mean the timing from earlier, 
right? I've already memorized it."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look, just like this— Hm-hmm♪ Hm, 
hm-hm-hm-hmm!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? You don't get it? Fine then, I'll 
run and show you♪

I watched to see what would happen, and 
she tore around the corner with flawless 
timing.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: See? I told you I memorized it, didn't I?
choice_data_list: Ah... But what about that song?
Yeah... But what about that song?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you don't know it? It's that super 
popular commercial song right now, "Wind's 
Twinkle Road," duh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Because the timing to make a move was just 
like that one♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And with that, good work today~~♡

From then on, Fusaichi Pandora's running 
grew even sharper.
